description: Georgia: Fulton County (Atlanta) Board of Assessors tax-digest parcels, published through the county's ArcGIS Hub open-data site. See docs/registry/data-policy.md and the review record in docs/registry/sources/ga-fulton-assessor.md.

sources.publisher: Fulton County Board of Assessors (via Fulton County GIS open data)
sources.license: Public record (Georgia Open Records Act, O.C.G.A. § 50-18-70 et seq.). The open-data site item declares licenseInfo CC-BY-SA and the 'Tax Parcels 2023' item says 'CC BY-SA'; the 'Tax Parcels 2025' item carries only an 'as is' disclaimer, and the Tax_CAMA and Property Profile document items say the data are 'for your personal use "as is"'. Not yet confirmed
sources.redistribution: CC-BY-SA at site level (attribution: Fulton County Board of Assessors / Fulton County GIS); the dataset items are silent or say 'personal use'. Not yet confirmed. Robert decided on 2026-11-06 that cited commercial facts from this public file may be kept. The publisher's own text is unchanged and still does not grant redistribution. See docs/registry/decisions/2026-11-06-cited-facts.md.
sources.notes: verified=false because the licence is unclear: the site says CC-BY-SA, the parcel item says only 'as is', and the two CAMA document items say 'for your personal use'. A person should confirm with Fulton County GIS (contact on gisdata.fultoncountyga.gov) that the Tax Parcels data may be redistributed under CC-BY-SA; then set verified=true. Files: the Hub CSV export of 'Tax Parcels 2025' (item c805da9aa51d4c508440358c00498fcf, the completed 2025 digest with values, owner, class and land-use codes; gisdata.fultoncountyga.gov redirects to hub.arcgis.com, which serves Tax_Parcels_2025.csv). 'Tax Parcels' (e581a072…, the live 2027 work-in-progress layer) and 'Tax Parcels 2026' (b50aaa86…) carry no value columns, so the 2025 item is the roll to load until the county republishes values. Tax_CAMAInfo.zip (63 MB, 2026-02-26; Tax_ParcelSupplement, Tax_Sales, Tax_StructureApartment/Commercial/Residential for tax year 2025) supplies year built and building area through the adapter's --structures option; PropertyProfile.zip (28 MB, 2026-02-26; one tab-delimited table for tax year 2026 with class and land-use descriptions, values blank, text fields cut at 30 characters) is kept only as the description table for the codes. gis.fultoncountyga.gov transfers ran at 25–50 KB/s and stalled twice after 7–9 MB on 2026-11-02 (both zips answer HEAD 200 with Accept-Ranges), so the collector could not archive the zips; retry off-peak. robots.txt: gisdata.fultoncountyga.gov and hub.arcgis.com set Crawl-delay 60 and disallow only /sites/, /admin/, /sessions/, /groups/, /people/, /workspace/; gis.fultoncountyga.gov and gismaps.fultoncountyga.gov have none (404); www.arcgis.com has no rules; services1.arcgis.com answers 403 to robots.txt.
